episodeTitle.en: The art and science of pricing | Madhavan Ramanujam (Monetizing Innovation, Simon-Kucher)
episodeTitle.zh: 定价的艺术与科学 | 马达万·拉马努贾姆（《创新变现》，西蒙-库彻出版社）

guestBioOfficial.en: Madhavan Ramanujam is a senior partner at Simon-Kucher, where he works with tier-one tech companies like Uber, Asana, and LinkedIn to help them develop their pricing and monetization strategies. He’s also the author of the most widely read book on pricing strategy, Monetizing Innovation. In today’s podcast, we talk about all the elements that go into your pricing strategy. Madhavan gives real-life examples of having conversations about “willingness to pay,” how segmentation should impact your pricing, and when to start thinking about pricing. He also shares tips on how behavioral pricing impacts your thinking, how to restructure your pricing during a downturn, and much more.
guestBioOfficial.zh: 马达万·拉马努贾姆是西蒙-库彻的高级合伙人，与优步、Asana和领英等顶级科技公司合作，帮助他们制定定价和货币化策略。他也是关于定价策略最受欢迎的书籍《创新变现》的作者。在今天的播客中，我们讨论了定价策略的所有要素。马达万给出了关于“支付意愿”对话的真实案例，细说分割策略如何影响定价，以及何时开始考虑定价。他还分享了行为定价如何影响思维、在经济低迷期间如何重组定价等诸多见解。
